name: pip-midnight-observatory
description: Pip's Midnight Observatory - A Retro Kids' Dream World Full-Stack Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render:build: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
